text:
Alicia: Quick sync - we need a small, partner-friendly policy for DP invites that covers scope decisions, credits, and infra runway.
Gabe: Short and prescriptive please. partners hate ambiguous promises.
Rina: From PM: propose 4 categories: `Blocker` (prevents pilot), `Integration` (API/schema/infra), `Capacity` (new nodes/quota), `UX` (copy/flows).
Omar: Ops: anything in `Capacity` needs 3+ weeks ops runway and infra signoff. call that out.
Alicia: SLA proposal: acknowledge within 48h for all asks; for `Blocker` we provide an ETA within 72h.
Gabe: Credits policy idea: only provide credits when we perform engineering work during the pilot window; require product+finance approval.
Rina: Ticketing: label as `dp:blocker|integration|capacity|ux` and add fields `dp:ack_by` and `dp:eta_if_blocker`. add `dp:credits_requested` boolean and `est_hours`.
Omar: Also include a short internal flow in the intake: SEs triage -> PM decision -> infra/legal/finance as needed. list owners in the intake form.
Gabe: QA-bot reminder: any ask that touches logging, retention, or access control must be flagged to Legal before dev starts.
Alicia: Decision: adopt the categories + SLA + credits rule. Action items:
- Rina: draft 2-line partner-facing blurb (48h ack, 72h blocker ETA, 3w runway for capacity, credits only for in-pilot engineering) by EOD.
- Omar: write ops runway checklist and minimum lead times (2 business days).
- Gabe: update ticket template with labels/fields and add brief guidance for SEs.
- QA-bot: logged compliance check requirement.
Rina: I'll keep the blurb plain english: "We triage partner requests within 48 hours. Issues that prevent the pilot from running will receive a target ETA within 72 hours. Work requiring infrastructure or capacity changes may need additional lead time (typically ~3 weeks); we'll flag this up front. Credits for engineering work performed during the pilot require product and finance approval."
Gabe: Sounds good. we'll trial for the next 6 pilots and iterate.
Omar: I'll sync with infra to confirm the 3-week guidance is realistic.
Alicia: Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
Gabe: :white_check_mark:
Rina: :sparkles:
QA-bot: Note: legal review required flag created for retention/logging/access changes.
